scope: neutral pre-run component-source ownership admission; no runtime proof

ios.component_subject: the resolved installed production file only
ios.bridge_subject: the separately installed ObserverBridge.swift, outside component subject
ios.native_dependency_requirement: fingerprint the actual pinned package/source dependency roots and bridge separately; this manifest is not dependency-completeness proof

android.production_entry: NativeQualificationProbe(marker: String, detail: String, onEvent: (String) -> Unit)
android.component_subject: the resolved installed app/src/main production file only
android.main_dependencies: existing compatible Compose/Material3 and standard platform classes; no JSON/serialization dependency added
android.native_dependency_requirement: fingerprint the actual admitted project/main dependencies and test bridge separately; this manifest is not dependency-completeness proof

variant_installation: base and repair-control install alternatives at the same production path in isolated checkouts; never compile both
forbidden_ownership_substitutions: test-view copy replacing imported production component
